title: Rightward Crossing with Window Growth
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-alphabet Turing machine with $k>0$ work tapes, choose a source symbol $a_0$, and let $c$ be a source configuration on the retracted input. Let $q$ be a source state, and suppose a table $s$ has the same optional symbols as the work-tape symbols scanned in $c$, while the source transition has a rightward crossing recorded by the head flags in $s$. For any integer frontier $z$ and left zipper list $l$, the simulator takes $k+2$ steps from the read phase to the reflected writing phase with the source transition's updated input-head position and output; the resulting right list is the reversed encoded right guard block appended to $l$, the left list consists of the boundary marker, and the work head stays between $z-1$ and $z+k$, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: decidable equality on the source alphabet
